group_gates._doc: Group-level gates apply within the implement phase only.
group_gates.enforcement: When GENESIS_CURRENT_GROUP env var is set and group > G1, accept-gate.mjs checks for a prior group approval record in approvals.json.
group_gates.G1: Requires only tasks-phase approval (no prior group).
group_gates.G2+: Requires approval record with phase:'implement' and group:'G(N-1)' before starting group N.
group_gates.approval_record: Group approvals use the standard schema with an additional 'group' field: { phase: 'implement', group: 'G1', status: 'approved', ... }
group_gates.exclusions: Group approvals support --exclude and --note flags, same as phase approvals.
group_gates.override: Use --force on /genesis-accept to re-approve an already-approved group.
group_gates.debugging: If a group gate blocks unexpectedly: 1) Check approvals.json for the prior group record. 2) Verify the group field matches exactly (e.g., 'G1' not 'g1'). 3) Check GENESIS_CURRENT_GROUP env var is set correctly.

_note: Maps each phase to its required upstream approval. Used by accept-gate.mjs and referenced by plan docs. Skill names are derived by prepending 'genesis-' or 'genesis:' to the key.
